>>>>>>> REPLACE

EDIT: app/src/worklog.ts
```
<<<<<<< SEARCH
    return Math.max(0, at - job.dueDay);
=======
    return Math.max(0, weekOf(at) - weekOf(job.dueDay));
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

`lateBy` now returns the difference between `weekOf(at)` and `weekOf(job.dueDay)`, floored at 0. It uses the file's existing `weekOf`, which I assumed is the yard week behind the weekly summaries. The no-due-day and dropped cases and the choice of measuring day are untouched.

I couldn't see the body of `weekOf` or `summariseWeek`. If the summaries compute their weeks some other way than through `weekOf`, tell me and I'll switch it.
